text: My office has heard concerns from local residents regarding road safety in their neighbourhoods, spanning Adelaide Street, and including and particularly in the vicinity of Portugal Square. In order to address these concerns, I’m seeking to lower the speed limit on this key street to improve road safety.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 40 kilometres per hour to 30 kilometres per hour on Adelaide Street West, between Shaw Street and Bathurst Street.
